title: cerastium decalvans f. alpicola
intro: Cerastium decalvans f. alpicola, commonly known as Alpine Snowflake or Mountain Snowflake, is a flowering plant species within the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in Cerastium decalvans f. alpicola include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
